dialogue.text: Good afternoon, private banking, Rachel Tan speaking. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak, or would you prefer that I call you back?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: No need to call back. Meeting finished already, and I'm in a quiet room. Usually the phone keeps ringing when I'm at my desk. Here better, nobody coming in.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: We can keep the conversation focused. Before we get into the details, is there anything about the way we present your portfolio updates that you would like us to change?

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: The updates ah, keep them concise. Put the main points at the top, then the supporting paperwork behind. During office hours I read on my phone, so if everything buried in a long attachment, quite hard to find.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I can note that presentation preference. A short covering message with the relevant documents attached would keep the correspondence together without making the message itself lengthy.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: That format easier. Running the business takes most of the day, then at home also got things to do. I still want to review my investments myself, just don't want to spend the evening hunting through emails.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: I will note your preference for concise correspondence. dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
dialogue.text: Thank you for separating the background from today's discussion. dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
